assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final game background illustration for Monopoli Nusantara, a luxurious Indonesian property trading board game. A wide cinematic handcrafted miniature Indonesian archipelago diorama floating over deep midnight indigo ocean, terraced emerald islands, tiny teak houses, a small gold-tipped monument, Balinese tiered roofs, pinisi sailboats, tropical greenery, soft warm lamps, richly textured matte resin and brass. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: eight-region illustration atlas used as original property card art in Monopoli Nusantara. Top row left to right: West Java tea hills and colonial garden villa; Central/East Java city with ancient temple and modern skyline; Sumatra traditional sweeping roof houses beside a river; East Java majestic volcanic mountain and colorful village. Bottom row left to right: Bali and Nusa Tenggara with multi-tier temple and tropical ocean; Kalimantan dense forest river with wooden stilt houses; Sulawesi and Maluku sailing harbor and curved traditional roof; Raja Ampat emerald karst islands meeting a sophisticated Jakarta skyscraper silhouette. Each is a standalone centered miniature scene within its exact cell, fully usable as property illustration. No people, no text, no Monopoly brand assets or mascots. Landscape 2:1 overall.
